name: FoxButton
summary: The button of the three apps: primary, secondary, danger and ghost, with icons, disabled and loading, in the phone and captain themes.

name: FoxIcon
summary: Every line icon of the first set on the 24 grid, at three sizes, as the apps draw them.

name: FoxField
summary: The frame of every form control: its label, optional marker, hint and error around the control.

name: FoxTextField
summary: A single-line text field: empty with a hint, filled with an icon, with an error and disabled.

name: FoxTextArea
summary: A multi-line field for order notes, with its counter and its error.

name: FoxSearchField
summary: The customer's search pill: empty, filled with its clear button, and loading.

name: FoxPhoneField
summary: The sign-in phone number with its country chip, Syria or Turkey, read left to right inside the right-to-left form.

name: FoxCodeField
summary: The six cells of the sign-in code: typing, wrong code and accepted.

name: FoxSelect
summary: A single choice from a list, its menu open under the field with the choice ticked, and empty with an error.

name: FoxDateField
summary: A date chosen from the calendar picker, shown with Western digits, and empty with an error.

name: FoxTimeField
summary: A time of day chosen from the picker, shown with «ص» and «م», and disabled.

name: FoxCheckbox
summary: A checkbox with its label: unchecked, checked, mixed, invalid and disabled.

name: FoxRadio
summary: Radio buttons in a named group with one tab stop: a choice made, an error and a disabled option.

name: FoxSwitch
summary: An on and off setting such as order notifications, enabled and disabled.

name: FoxQuantityStepper
summary: The quantity of a cart line: minus becomes delete at the minimum, plus stops at the maximum.

name: FoxMoney
summary: An amount in Western tabular digits with its currency, in its sizes, signs and tones, for the phone and the captain.

name: FoxStatusChip
summary: The nine order states as tinted chips with an icon and words, compact for dense lists, and a free tone.

name: FoxCountBadge
summary: A dot or a count on an icon's corner, 99+ when large, orange for the cart and inline in a tab.

name: FoxCard
summary: The card shell: an outline, the customer app's offset shadow, a pressable card and a late one.

name: FoxListRow
summary: A row of a list or settings page: pressable with its chevron, with a value or a chip, danger and disabled.

name: FoxTimer
summary: An order's countdown, calm, soon and in minutes, and the late time counting up, for the restaurant and the captain.

name: FoxCountdownRing
summary: The ring around the captain's new offer, emptying over its 45 seconds.

name: FoxOrderCard
summary: The restaurant board's order card with its timer and one main action, new and late.

name: FoxOrderRow
summary: A row of the customer's «طلباتي» list: the restaurant, the date, the state and the total.

name: FoxLogo
summary: A restaurant's logo, or its initials when it has none, in a circle.

name: FoxAmountsSummary
summary: The money lines of an order and its total: the customer cart's orange total bar, and plain elsewhere.

name: FoxRestaurantCard
summary: The customer's restaurant card with its rating, time and fee, a favourite, and closed with its reopening time.

name: FoxDishCard
summary: A menu dish row with its square photo and «+»: in the cart, unavailable and plain.

name: FoxSkeleton
summary: The calm loading blocks in the shape of the content that comes, still under reduced motion.

name: FoxEmptyState
summary: An empty list and an error in the logo's drop, with one action.

name: FoxDialog
summary: A question that blocks the screen, its safe action first in focus, in the phone and captain themes.

name: FoxConfirmDialog
summary: The confirmation of a destructive or financial action: a required reason, the money effect and who is notified.

name: FoxBottomSheet
summary: A sheet from the bottom: the customer's item sheet with the S-curve tab, and the restaurant's plain status sheet.

name: FoxToast
summary: The dark blue toast in its four tones, with an action; FoxToaster shows one at a time above the bottom bar.

name: FoxBanner
summary: The banners under the top bar: red solid, then yellow, amber, blue and grey tinted, each with an icon and words.

name: FoxBannerStack
summary: The banners in their priority order: two shown and the rest behind a counter that opens them.

name: FoxMenu
summary: A list of actions under its trigger, a destructive one after a separator.

name: FoxTabs
summary: Underline tabs with counts for boards and detail pages, and the customer's pill tabs.

name: FoxTopBar
summary: The phone apps' bar: the round back button, the orange title and an optional end action.

name: FoxRestaurantBar
summary: The restaurant app's bar: its name, the status pill, the connection dot with its word and the support button.

name: FoxBottomNavigation
summary: The Figma file's floating bar, icons only, in the customer, restaurant and captain apps.

name: FoxNavigationRail
summary: The restaurant's rail on the start side, on tablets and Windows.

name: FoxPullToRefresh
summary: Pull to refresh with the mark filling as you pull, then the drop loader while it loads.

name: FoxDropLoader
summary: The project's one loader: the mark fills with a swaying liquid, then fades back; 16, 24 and 48, and inside a busy button.

name: FoxCountrySheet
summary: The phone field's country list: a search by name or calling code, Syria and Turkey first, then the last used.

name: FoxTextLink
summary: Underlined primary words that act, with a 48 target around them.

name: FoxTrackingSteps
summary: An order's way in four steps: done in blue, the current one orange with a soft pulse, the rest dashed.

name: FoxSignInHero
summary: The sign-in screen's head by where the guest came from: the saved cart, the way an order is followed, or what an account keeps.

name: FoxCodePreview
summary: What the WhatsApp message with the code will look like, the code masked; full and compact.

name: FoxVersionTicket
summary: The forced update's head: a ticket with the installed version struck and the required one below.

name: FoxShopSign
summary: The maintenance head: an orange board hung from a nail, with the return time when the panel gives one.
